cell_line.evidence: Caco‐2 cells were purchased from the European Collection of Cell Cultures (ECACC, Salisbury, UK) and used between passage p15−35.

cell_type.evidence: To probe the mechanism of intestinal epithelial translocation of human milk EVs, specifically to identify any EV proteins that may facilitate transport, we used quantitative proteomics to analyse EVs following intestinal transport.

disease_state.evidence: inferred: EVs were isolated from human milk by a pH adjustment and differential ultracentrifugation process optimised based on previous studies (Zhang et al.,).

material_type.evidence: inferred: Human milk was kindly donated by the Hearts Milk Bank (Hertfordshire, UK).

sample_source.evidence: Human milk was kindly donated by the Hearts Milk Bank (Hertfordshire, UK).

tissue.evidence: inferred: we studied the interaction of human milk EVs with the gut barrier components, including intestinal biofluids, enzymes, mucus and epithelium.
